ScrapShell PH-CPF Viewer

ScrapShell · PH-CPF

Planar hexagonal meshing with coordinate power fields (Pluta, Edelstein, Vaxman, Ben-Chen 2021), reproduced as the baseline for scrap-panel shells.

Model

Pipeline

    Precomputed with the authors' MATLAB field energies, Directional for integration and meshing, and ScrapShell's dualizer and planarizer. δ = 0.5% of the bounding-box diagonal, η = 0.2% of the area, planarity target 1%.
